revisions.name: $crt_callback_complete
revisions.reason: Review 20261118 gears VS2012: _initterm_e uses retained CRT mode3 with the existing child/root/parent/expected-ESP validation and per-invocation cursor/result. Mode3 scans NULL-skipping forward table slots, calls cdecl initializers, stops on first nonzero EAX and returns that exact DWORD; empty/success returns zero. Only exit modes drain the registry/close streams. New CACA0042 continuation authenticates mode3 before any return handling; unchanged void/exit paths remain distinct. Authored real PE native and normal Worker oldfail/newpass, nested error/success and callee-saved/ESP tests plus existing init/exit ownership negatives qualify the bounded addition. General ownership remains pending.
